Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add substrate recipe system with automatic kg calculation

This update implements a complete recipe-based substrate management system
that automatically calculates bag_kg_substrat based on the number of bags
and the substrate mix recipe.

Changes:
- Add recipe_ingredients (JSON) and grams_per_bag fields to SubstrateMix model
- Create database migration for new substrate recipe fields
- Implement SubstrateMixManager UI with ingredient editor (8 ingredients)
- Add automatic bag_kg_substrat calculation: bags × (grams_per_bag / 1000)
- Add read-only "Kg substrat" column to BatchTable
- Update BE% calculation to use auto-calculated kg substrat values

Features:
- Ingredient list: Hardwood pellets, Softwood pellets, Sagflis, Luserne, 
  Soyamel, Kli, Gips, Vann
- Automatic dry weight calculation (excludes water)
- Recipe stored as JSON for flexibility
- Auto-calculation runs on batch create/update when bag count changes

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
